title: Subarray Sums Divisible by K
summary: Given an integer array and an integer k, count the number of non-empty contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by k.
statement: Given an integer array and an integer k, count the number of non-empty contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by k.
constraints: k is positive; nums may contain negative values.
Count nonempty contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by k.
hints: A subarray sum is divisible by k when its endpoint prefix remainders are equal.
Count previously seen remainders while scanning prefix sums.
Add count[current remainder], then increment it; seed remainder zero once.
Each equal-remainder prefix pair identifies exactly one qualifying subarray.
editorial: Each equal-remainder prefix pair identifies exactly one qualifying subarray.

tests.explanation: Seven subarrays have prefix endpoints with equal remainder modulo five.
Five is not divisible by nine, so the count is zero.
